name: M3_DPS001MI_AddRelDistrWhs
description: Creates a distribution relationship between a source and destination warehouse, defining how goods are supplied between them. Configuration options include transport time, delivery method, validity dates, document rules, capacities, and costing factors. Supports general warehouse-to-warehouse relations and relations controlled by distribution group or multiple-supply setup. Used by M3 in the supply chain network for warehouse distribution, delivery-date calculations, lead-time planning, and distribution costing.

inputParameters.name: RLTY
inputParameters.description: Relation type defining whether the warehouse relationship is maintained directly between warehouses, by distribution group, or by item and warehouse.

inputParameters.name: FWLO
inputParameters.description: Warehouse from which goods are distributed in this relation.

inputParameters.name: TWLO
inputParameters.description: Warehouse to which goods are distributed in this relation.

inputParameters.name: DIKY
inputParameters.description: Distribution key identifying the group or item grouping used by the selected relation type.

inputParameters.name: STDT
inputParameters.description: Date from which this warehouse distribution relation is valid.

inputParameters.name: TRDY
inputParameters.description: Number of workdays needed to transport goods between the warehouses.

inputParameters.name: TRTE
inputParameters.description: Estimated transportation time in hours between the warehouses.

inputParameters.name: TRDC
inputParameters.description: Distance between the warehouses used in distribution cost calculations.

inputParameters.name: DORC
inputParameters.description: Document requirement indicating whether transport documents are not needed, created manually, or required in full.

inputParameters.name: FWNO
inputParameters.description: Forwarding agent used for transport between the warehouses.

inputParameters.name: MODL
inputParameters.description: Delivery method used for transportation between the warehouses.

inputParameters.name: TEDL
inputParameters.description: Delivery terms defining when responsibility for the delivery transfers between the parties.

inputParameters.name: DCMU
inputParameters.description: Multiplier used to calculate transport-related distribution costs for goods moved between the warehouses.

inputParameters.name: COWC
inputParameters.description: Average daily weight capacity available for distribution between the warehouses.

inputParameters.name: COVC
inputParameters.description: Average daily volume capacity available for distribution between the warehouses.

inputParameters.name: COCA
inputParameters.description: Average daily number of containers that can be sent between the warehouses.

inputParameters.name: ADDY
inputParameters.description: Indicates whether delivery is normally permitted on the specified weekday for this relation.

inputParameters.name: TODT
inputParameters.description: Date until which this warehouse distribution relation is valid.

inputParameters.name: RLSH
inputParameters.description: Relative share of the requested quantity planned to be supplied through this warehouse relation.
